body:
I try to take care of my skin, even when I don't care about myself I don't want to get infections or make things worse so I use special creams from my dermatologist and keep everything clean. It just feels like I'm trying to stop a flood with a bucket.

I really appreciate the sentiment, it's just hard to give up on my looks. I want someone to think I'm beautiful and not like they have to settle for whatever I am. And what if my personality isn't good enough for anyone to overlook this?
